notes: Category tree harvested from Birch Lane's own sitemaps declared in robots.txt (seo-category-sitemap~0.xml, 93 /cat/ URLs; seo-sb0-sitemap~0.xml, 244 /sb0/ leaf browse URLs); sub-category names follow the site's own slugs. This machine's IPv4 egress is dead (A-only hosts unreachable), so birchlane.com was fetched through the IPv6-reachable Google translate host www-birchlane-com.translate.goog, which returns Birch Lane's genuine server-rendered Next.js RSC payload. Every qty is the site's own BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount data.resultCount, accepted only where it matched pageTrackingMetadata totalSKUCount on the same page - all accepted rows matched exactly. The 'link' values are the canonical www.birchlane.com URLs, not the translate.goog ones. Scope per assignment: Lighting, Decor and Kitchen/Tabletop trees only - Furniture, Bathroom, Storage, Baby & Kids, Rugs, Bedding, Outdoor and Holiday trees excluded wholesale. Also dropped per brief: wall clocks, textiles (throw pillows, pillow covers, blankets & throws, curtains, valances, kitchen towels, placemats/napkins), cookware and kitchen appliances, knives, kitchen gadgets and prep tools, flatware sets and serving utensils, cabinet knobs & pulls, sinks & faucets, tile, wallpaper, wall shelves, decorative baskets, organizational decor, fireplace & hearth, light bulbs and ceiling fans. No count is a round cap value; counts vary independently per category, confirming they are not a site-wide total. Method validated by pagination: Vases reports 407 at a page size of 48, and curpage=9 server-renders exactly 23 product tiles (407-384) while curpage=10 returns a 302 - so resultCount is a true total, not a display cap. 8 mid-level /cat/ hub pages were dropped from the original 55-URL tree (Ceiling Lights, Wall Lights, Lamps & Lamp Shades, Candlelight & Fragrances, Decorative Objects, Botanicals, Wall Decor, Teapots & Creamers): each returns a ~1MB payload with no server-rendered product grid and no count block (confirmed over 8 retries each, vs 2.5MB and 48 tiles for a real listing page), and each is a strict parent of leaf sub-categories already listed here, so keeping them would double-count at merge. NOTE for merge: two retained rows are themselves broader listing pages that overlap narrower ones - 'Wall Art' (466) spans Framed Wall Art (169), Canvas Wall Art (136) and Wall Art Sets (69); 'Mirrors' (415) spans Wall Mirrors (372) and Floor & Full Length Mirrors (45). Both are genuine site browse categories with their own server-rendered counts, so they are kept, but do not sum these rows as if disjoint.
